description: System tray monitor for the usage limits of Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and GitHub Copilot.
notes: AgentGauge is installed to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Gauge by its own installer, not into the Scoop apps folder.
It updates itself on launch by default, so 'scoop list' can show an older version than the one running; 'scoop hold' does not stop this. Turn it off in AgentGauge's settings.
Exit AgentGauge from its tray icon before running 'scoop uninstall'. Your settings in %APPDATA%\Gauge are kept.

script: # Scoop also runs this during 'scoop update', and the Inno uninstaller deletes the start-on-boot Run value.
# The wiki documents $cmd, but current Scoop holds the command in $subCommand, so both are read.
